text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026 fired — Synthetic prober failures detected (multiwave)
incident-bot: Summary: prober failure rate > 30% over 5m across us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Prober group: synthetic/canary-main.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026 created and paged: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026

sam.olmsted: @pagerduty-bot acked. I'm on it. Starting quick triage.
benji: oncall? seeing the same in the dashboard — large spike around 11:03 UTC.
carol-ng: thx sam. are any customer-facing routes broken or just probes?
benji: initial metric overlay looks probe-only but need to confirm. app-layer SLOs look ok.
jules.ops: tagging infra/network since it's across regions. @maria-le can you eyeball any WAF change?
maria-le: no WAF deploys in last 24h on record. checking firewall logs for probe IPs now.
sam.olmsted: running PromQL on synth success rate:```
sum by(region) (rate(synth_probe_success_total[5m])) / sum by(region) (rate(synth_probe_total[5m]))
```

sam.olmsted: result: us-west-2 ~68% -> 29% in last 10m, eu-west-1 ~65% -> 31%. other regions stable ~99%.
eve: (reaction: :eyes:)

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026 acknowledged by sam.olmsted at 11:06 UTC. Escalation window opens in 7m if no resolution.

benji: I can ssh into the probe runner in us-west-2 to tail logs: `journalctl -u synth-prober -f`
benji: seeing a lot of connection resets and 429 responses from our edge balancer: `upstream response: 429 Too Many Requests`
carol-ng: 429 from edge means the probe worker is being rate-limited at edge layer. Could be a new rate-limiting policy or a sudden fanout from prober.
sre-tac: did we change probe fanout config or concurrency? I recall a config roll last week to increase concurrency for bursts.
maria-le: confirmed no recent config changes to prober from product. but there was an infra autoscaler test earlier that briefly increased probe pods — maybe left a higher concurrency flag on the cluster? checking k8s events.

sam.olmsted: ok next steps: 1) reduce prober concurrency to a safe baseline, 2) throttle prober requests on the client, 3) request temporary edge rate-limit whitelist for probe IPs while we investigate.
jules.ops: I'll open an emergency support ticket with CDN/edge team to whitelist probe CIDR for next 30m. pinging them now.

eve: note for timeline: first spike 11:02, PD fired 11:04, ack 11:06.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026 escalated to level-2 (sre-tac) due to cross-region impact.

benji: decreased prober concurrency from 50 -> 8 on us-west-2 and eu-west-1 clusters. applying change now: `kubectl -n synthetic set env deploy/prober PROBER_CONCURRENCY=8`
benji: change applied. tail shows successful probe requests resuming, 200s returning.

sam.olmsted: edge team confirmed temporary whitelist applied for probe CIDRs at 11:12 UTC. seeing success rate climb.

maria-le: firewall logs show spikes of 429s due to a misapplied rate-limit rule on the edge that had a low per-src TPS. root cause: an automated rule promotion on the edge control plane rolled a conservative rule to prod at 10:58 UTC.
jules.ops: filed CR to revert that rule; edge team scheduled rollback in 15m.

carol-ng: customer impact check: no production customer errors or latency SLO breaches observed in the last 30m. traffic routes for user requests are healthy. this looks isolated to synthetic prober traffic hitting the edge limit. marking P0? I'd say P1 since no customer impact. thoughts?
sre-tac: agree — P1. We should still run postmortem because this rule was promoted without correlating probe IPs.

sam.olmsted: monitoring: creating a temporary synthetic health alert suppression for PD to avoid repeated noise while we finish. I'll set suppression window 11:15–12:00 UTC.

pagerduty-bot: PD suppression set by sam.olmsted for INC-2026 (11:15–12:00 UTC).

benji: confirming stabilization: us-west-2 success rate 98% at 11:18, eu-west-1 97% at 11:19.

maria-le: edge rollback executed at 11:25 UTC. rule reverted. no further 429s in logs.

jules.ops: will follow up with edge team on why promo pipeline lacked exclusion for internal probe CIDRs. blocking action: require tag-based exclusion or explicit allowlist in promotion playbook.

sam.olmsted: handoff: I'm green and will keep incident on-monitor for 30m. @jules.ops please continue coordination with edge. @sre-tac please own the follow-up and postmortem.
sre-tac: on it. target postmortem draft by EOD. will include timeline, root cause (edge rule promotion), action items (promotion gating, probe CIDR allowlist, alert noise suppression policy).

carol-ng: brief customer message prepared — "We detected transient synthetic check failures in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 starting at 11:02 UTC; internal monitoring triggered alerts but user-facing services were not impacted. Engineers mitigated the cause and services are stable." I'll share draft with SRE for sign-off.

sam.olmsted: great work everyone. closing incident thread here but keeping channel pinned for follow-ups. (reaction: :white_check_mark:)

incident-bot: INC-2026 status changed to Monitoring by sam.olmsted at 11:35 UTC.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026 resolved by sam.olmsted at 11:50 UTC — root cause: edge rate-limit rule promotion affected probe traffic.

sre-tac: final note: no customer-facing regressions observed; follow-up actions tracked in internal ticket INF-4371. I'll add owners and ETA for each action item.
